title: FIT_PLANE payload
description: Plane fit on selected cloud points, applied as a PLANE measurement or as the new supportPlane of a face (v0.3 §7; spec §9, §10.12 rule 4).

selection.description: Rectangle or lasso in the view as a LOCAL-frame box or plan polygon with height range (D-132, Q-18).

faceId.description: FACE_PLANE only: the face whose supportPlane is replaced.
